AppealHandoff.description: Initial-PA denial → appeal handoff: which appeal scenario to launch.
AppealHandoff.title: AppealHandoff

AppealRequest.description: Strict-validated HTTP request body for POST /api/appeal/generate.
AppealRequest.title: AppealRequest

AuditProvenance.description:
What the outbound artifact was when it left the system (S2 Slice 4).

AI-accountability provenance (CLAUDE.md §AI Output Accountability): the
audit trail must record what was actually verified before an artifact
reached a payer, not just that a pipeline ran. `as_is` = machine output,
no human in the loop (all pipeline-boundary writes); `gatekeeper_corrected`
arrives with the S4 blocking claim→citation gatekeeper; the HITL resume
flow stamps `human_approved` when a reviewer cleared the draft unchanged
(a decision, not an edit — May's ruling 2026-07-18, ADR-0009 amendment)
and `human_edited` only when the letter text actually changed.
AuditProvenance.title: AuditProvenance

AuditRecord.description:
One entry per pipeline run — done or error, either lifecycle.

Identifiers and hashes only, never letter/request text (PHI rule).
Idempotent on ``idempotency_key`` = case_id + attempt (ADR-0009);
``correlation_id`` coincides with it pre-DB, so a single ID traces logs,
the terminal event, and this record.
AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord

AuditRecordsResponse.description:
Response body for GET /api/audit/records (S3 Task 3).

Returns :class:`AuditRecord` entries as-is (already identifiers-and-hashes
only by design). Wrapped for the same forward-compat reason as
:class:`PendingReviewsResponse`.
AuditRecordsResponse.title: AuditRecordsResponse

CaseTier.description:
Deterministic HITL review tier (S3 Slice 2). Assigned by the
TierRouter node — pure rule logic, never an LLM (regulatory + safety
constraint: Illinois, MD HB 1563). Mirrors the pre-existing types.ts
union — parity-tested in test_schema_parity.py.
CaseTier.title: CaseTier

ConflictSource.description:
One side of a 'conflict' criterion — a source and the claim it asserts.

Surfaced (instead of silently picking one) when two documents disagree.
ConflictSource.title: ConflictSource

InitialPaDoneEvent.description:
Success terminal for the initial-PA stream (S2 Slice 1, spec-first).

Same ``done``/``error`` contract as the appeal stream — every stream ends
with exactly one of them — but lifecycle-shaped payload: the CRD result,
the payer determination (absent when the CRD early-exits with "PA not
required"), and the appeal handoff pointer when denied. Launching the
appeal stays a separate, human-gated request.
InitialPaDoneEvent.title: InitialPaDoneEvent

InitialPaRequest.description:
Strict-validated HTTP request body for the initial-PA lifecycle (S2).

Deliberately NOT an AppealRequest extension (Sprint 2 standing rule): an
initial PA precedes any payer decision, so there is no denial to quote,
and the flow it drives (CRD check → assemble → PAS submit → determination)
is a different artifact on a different transmission rail
(05-state-lifecycle.md).
InitialPaRequest.title: InitialPaRequest

LoginRequest.description:
Strict-validated request body for POST /api/auth/login.

Checked with constant-time comparison against the ``DEMO_USER`` /
``DEMO_PASSWORD`` env vars (the pre-DB demo credential store).
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

LoginResponse.description:
Response body for a successful login.

The session id itself is delivered only as the httpOnly ``paxos_session``
cookie (never in the body, so JS cannot read it). ``csrf_token`` IS returned
in the body so the SPA can echo it in the ``X-CSRF-Token`` header on
cookie-authenticated writes (double-submit CSRF defense).
LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse

MeResponse.description: Response body for GET /api/auth/me — the current session's user.
MeResponse.title: MeResponse

PaDecision.description:
Payer determination decision on an initial-PA submission (S2 Slice 1).

The submission finalizes after one determination. Unresolved evidence
stays pended on replay. A denial includes a pointer for a human to
start an appeal (05-state-lifecycle.md).
PaDecision.title: PaDecision

PaOutcome.description: Payer determination after a PAS submission (initial-PA lifecycle).
PaOutcome.title: PaOutcome

PaRequired.description:
CRD pre-check result: is a PA required for this drug × plan, and why.

``required`` is ``None`` when the answer is unknown (no requirement on
file for this drug × plan): the case goes to a person, never to "PA not
required". ``False`` means a source actually said no PA is needed.
PaRequired.title: PaRequired

PendingReviewItem.description:
One parked exception-tier run awaiting human review (S3 Task 3).

Metadata only — never the letter/request text (CLAUDE.md PHI rule). A
reviewer surfaces the queue with this; the draft body is a deferred Slice
4c surface. ``parked_at`` is the timestamp of the exception ``done`` audit
record (when the run parked at ``hold``). ``tier`` is always ``exception``
today (only that tier parks), carried explicitly so the shape survives if
another tier ever gains a review checkpoint.
PendingReviewItem.title: PendingReviewItem

PendingReviewsResponse.description:
Response body for GET /api/reviews/pending (S3 Task 3).

Wrapped (not a bare array) so the payload can gain top-level metadata
without a breaking change.
PendingReviewsResponse.title: PendingReviewsResponse

ResumeAppealRequest.description:
Strict-validated HTTP request body for POST /api/appeal/resume (S3
Slice 4b): a human clears a parked exception-tier run for submission.

``correlation_id`` is the parked run's handle — the value carried on that
run's terminal ``DoneEvent`` (= its checkpoint ``thread_id``). When
``edited_text`` is present it replaces the drafted letter as the outbound
artifact; the resume records ``provenance=human_edited`` when the text
actually changed and ``human_approved`` when the draft was cleared as-is.
ResumeAppealRequest.title: ResumeAppealRequest

post.description:
Stream an appeal letter as Server-Sent Events.

Authentication: enforced by the auth_middleware before this is reached.

Returns a ``text/event-stream`` response emitting ``step``, ``chunk``,
``done``, and ``error`` events.

Resume a parked exception-tier appeal run for a human reviewer (S3
Slice 4b).

Authentication: enforced by the auth_middleware before this is reached,
which also resolves the caller identity onto ``request.state`` — passed down
as ``reviewed_by`` for the resume audit entry (ADR-0013). The handler stays
logic-free: it reads a plain value, it does not parse auth.
No LLM_BACKEND required — the resume path invokes no model.

Returns a ``text/event-stream`` emitting a terminal ``done`` (the human
reviewed/edited letter) or ``error`` (nothing awaiting review for the
given ``correlation_id``).

get.description:
List the audit trail (S3 Task 3) — read-only, metadata + hashes only.

Authentication + tenant scoping: enforced by the auth_middleware before this
is reached, which resolves the caller's :class:`TenancyScope` onto
``request.state`` (session tenant, or platform for a Bearer caller). The
handler stays logic-free — it reads a plain value and passes it to the
fail-closed store boundary; a session sees only its tenant's records
(ADR-0017), a service caller sees all.

post.description: Validate demo credentials, mint a session, set the httpOnly cookie.
Destroy the session and clear the cookie.

get.description: Return the current session's user (401 if there is no session).

post.description:
Run the initial-PA lifecycle as Server-Sent Events.

Authentication: enforced by the auth_middleware before this is reached.

Returns a ``text/event-stream`` response emitting ``step`` and a terminal
``done`` (InitialPaDoneEvent) or ``error`` event — never ``chunk``
(no LLM in this path).

get.description:
List exception-tier runs awaiting human review (S3 Task 3).

Authentication + tenant scoping: enforced by the auth_middleware, which
resolves the caller's :class:`TenancyScope` onto ``request.state``. Metadata
only — never the draft body (a deferred Slice 4c surface). The queue is
derived from the audit trail (ADR-0011); the handler wires the tenant-scoped
store snapshot and the live parked-check into the pure derivation, so the
queue is scoped through the same fail-closed store boundary as the audit
listing (a session sees only its tenant's parked runs; a service caller all).
Unauthenticated health check — used by load balancers and CI smoke tests.
